featured_reviews.review_text:
Vardhaman Jewellers is the one-stop destination for all your needs if you are looking for exquisite bridal jewellery or light, everyday western accessories. Quality, purity of the products, gratifying customer services and warm hospitality are the hallmarks of the Vardhaman Jewellers.

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Bhanushali
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently made a purchase at Vardhaman Jewellers, expecting a high-quality product based on their reputation, but my experience was extremely disappointing. I bought a gold ring, and the purity was marked as 916 on the bail. However, after a proper test, it turned out the actual purity was only 18 carat, which is about 75%. This is a clear case of misleading information and poor transparency.

It's frustrating to trust a well-known jeweller with an expensive item, only to find out that they are not being honest about the purity of the gold. This kind of false advertising and lack of honesty is unacceptable, especially in such a trusted industry.

I would advise anyone considering purchasing from Vardhaman Jewellers to think twice before making a decision. I certainly won’t be returning, and I highly recommend others to be cautious and verify the authenticity of their products before buying.

Such practices not only damage their reputation but also put customers at a disadvantage. Very disappointed with this purchase!

featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter has gifted me these rose gold plated earrings which were purchased by her online. This was in February 2026. The first time the earrings were delivered in a broken box and the screws of both the earrings were not holding to the threading and were coming out.
First  replacement came with screws of different sizes and rose gold plating was scraped. The second replacement  was delivered ( attached in photo) also with plating all scraped out as seen in the picture. The entire process of replacements took one and half month. The warranty is for the plating, it seems.
When the  product was replaced twice with scraped plating, though it was rose gold plated, what warranty is Giva offering? This is Cheating. The cost of rose gold plating was included and the earrings were delivered with scraped plating.
The same pair of earrings was delivered as replacement twice by scraping the rose gold plating. This is disgusting . I had put a mark on the box thats how I noticed that same pair was scraped and delivered.
There is no refund but they said they will transfer the amount in the wallet so that the customer buys another fake Giva ' gold plating scraped' product and start the return and replacement journey again. How can anyone trust Giva products????? Why was the gold plating scraped? Why was it not plated again? This is how customers are taken for a ride. Very shameful Giva!!! Total waste of hard earned money.
Giva, if you are reading this, take your fake earrings back and return the money to source if you are GENUINE.
